units.source_text: 老师告诉我们母子俩可以退出房间了。

en.t: The teacher told my mother and me that we could leave the room.

units.source_text: 我们再三施了礼便从房间里走了出来。

en.t: After bowing again and again, we walked out of the room.

units.source_text: 小书院朝南，面对中院的五铺席宽的储藏室就是我的房间。

en.t: The small study faced south, and the five-mat-wide storeroom facing the inner courtyard was my room.

units.source_text: 剩下我们两人在这里的时候，母亲哭了。

en.t: When only the two of us were left there, my mother wept.
